segments.text: Maria saved the transcript as a text file; she did not save the original recording.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: Transcription took 12 minutes. Translation into Greek has not started yet.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

reference_translations: Η Μαρία αποθήκευσε το κείμενο της απομαγνητοφώνησης ως αρχείο κειμένου· δεν αποθήκευσε την αρχική ηχογράφηση.
Η απομαγνητοφώνηση διήρκεσε 12 λεπτά. Η μετάφραση στα ελληνικά δεν έχει ξεκινήσει ακόμη.
review_criteria: Distinguish the transcript text, the transcription process and the original audio recording.
Preserve that the text was saved but the original recording was not.
Preserve that transcription is complete and translation has not started, rather than claiming that translation took 12 minutes.
Maria may remain in Latin letters or be rendered naturally as Μαρία.

segments.text: Ο Νίκος έστειλε το κείμενο στην Ελένη, όχι στην Έλενα.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: Η Ελένη είναι η μεταφράστρια. Ο Νίκος κάνει την ηχογράφηση και η Έλενα ελέγχει τους υπότιτλους.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

reference_translations: Nikos sent the text to Eleni, not to Elena.
Eleni is the translator. Nikos does the recording, and Elena checks the subtitles.
review_criteria: Keep Eleni and Elena as two distinct people and assign each the correct role.
Nikos sent the text to Eleni; Elena was not the recipient.
Do not add an unnatural English article before a person's name.
Reasonable transliteration variants are acceptable if the people remain consistently distinguishable.

segments.text: The receipt shows €12.50 for 2 items. The separate transfer is 5,000 sats, not 500 sats.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: The note mentions Bitcoin. It does not say that euros and sats are the same unit.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

reference_translations: Η απόδειξη γράφει €12.50 για 2 είδη. Η ξεχωριστή μεταφορά είναι 5,000 sats, όχι 500 sats.
Η σημείωση αναφέρει το Bitcoin. Δεν λέει ότι τα ευρώ και τα sats είναι η ίδια μονάδα.
review_criteria: Preserve the values 12.50 euros, 2 items, 5000 sats and the explicitly rejected amount of 500 sats.
Locale-appropriate rendering such as 12,50 and 5.000 is valid if the numerical values are unchanged; literal-number flags alone are not errors.
Keep the receipt and transfer separate and retain the statement that euros and sats are different units.
Translate the ordinary English prose into Greek while allowing Bitcoin, sats and displayed receipt labels to remain as technical notation.

segments.text: Δεν είπα ότι η Άννα πούλησε όλα τα βιβλία. Είπα ότι δεν πούλησε κανένα χθες.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

segments.text: Σήμερα μπορεί να πουλήσει ένα, αλλά αυτό δεν έχει αποφασιστεί.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

reference_translations: I did not say that Anna sold all the books. I said that she did not sell any yesterday.
She may sell one today, but that has not been decided.
review_criteria: Preserve both scopes: denial of having said 'sold all', and the positive report that she sold none yesterday.
Do not turn 'did not sell any' into 'did not sell all', which allows some sales.
Today's possible sale remains undecided rather than certain or completed.
Judge complete propositions; merely retaining a token such as 'not' does not establish correct negation.

segments.text: Anna will publish the video only if Giannis approves the text.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: If Giannis does not answer by Friday, Anna will wait until Monday.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

reference_translations: Η Άννα θα δημοσιεύσει το βίντεο μόνο αν ο Γιάννης εγκρίνει το κείμενο.
Αν ο Γιάννης δεν απαντήσει μέχρι την Παρασκευή, η Άννα θα περιμένει μέχρι τη Δευτέρα.
review_criteria: Giannis approves and Anna publishes; do not reverse their roles.
Approval is a necessary condition: retain 'only if', not merely a possible reason for publication.
The no-answer condition concerns Giannis, not Anna.
Retain Friday as the response deadline and Monday as the end of the waiting period.

segments.text: Η Μαρία ρώτησε: «Το αρχείο έχει 12 κεφάλαια ή 21;»
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: Δεν γνωρίζουμε ακόμη την απάντηση. Ο τίτλος μόνος του δεν αρκεί για να το διαπιστώσουμε.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

reference_translations: Maria asked: 'Does the file have 12 chapters or 21?'
We do not know the answer yet. The title alone is not enough to establish that.
review_criteria: Keep the first sentence as a quoted question with two alternatives; do not choose a count.
Retain the explicit uncertainty and the insufficiency of the title as evidence.
Do not invent an answer or convert the question into a factual statement.
